first.text:
within the round 1 folder:

Build a single-file index.html (inline CSS and JS, no build step, no external libraries or network requests) containing an evolving ecosystem simulation of plants, prey, and predators on a 2D grid. It must auto-start on page load and run for N generations on its own. Each creature carries a gene vector (speed, vision, metabolism, reproduction threshold) or a tiny neural net that mutates on reproduction. Use a seeded PRNG for all randomness so the same seed always reproduces the same run, and keep the simulation logic separate from rendering so it can also run headless and faster than real time.  The design is the main deliverable. Treat the simulation as a living specimen under glass, and make the controls part of the composition rather than a form beside it. Pick one distinctive visual direction suited to the subject (for example a naturalist’s field journal, a bioluminescent deep-sea observatory, or a scientific plate), with a deliberate palette, a considered type pairing, and one memorable signature element. Give each species its own color and glyph language. Put every variable (seed, mutation rate, food regrowth, generations, speed, catastrophe intervals) in an integrated control surface, such as a collapsible side drawer, a docked instrument panel, or controls anchored to the world itself. Use custom-styled sliders, dials, steppers, and toggles with live value readouts, units, and sensible ranges. Add a small sparkline next to each knob showing its effect, and give each control tooltips, keyboard support, and visible focus states. Changes should apply live with smooth feedback.   Add a scheduled catastrophe system (drought, plague, and one of your choosing) that fires automatically at configurable intervals. Announce each event with a restrained, on-theme visual moment, such as a screen tint, a banner, or a timeline marker, and mark it on the charts. When the run ends, transition into a polished dashboard with population curves and trait-drift charts (mean and spread per gene per species), all drawn on canvas in the same visual language.

tasks.subject: Designer: visual system CSS + instrument folio controls
tasks.description:
Read DESIGN-BRIEF.md and src/shell.html first. Own and build:
1) src/design.css — full visual system for the page: desk/sheet, procedural paper texture, masthead typography (Bodoni/Didot display + Optima small caps + mono data), plate head + live census tags, brass/glass vitrine mount and screws, generation rule, field-notes ledger, instrument folio + fold tab, tooltips, specimen card, event banner, active-condition note, recast note, wash overlay, shortcut note, focus-visible states, prefers-reduced-motion, responsive rules down to 1024px. Target 1440x900 with no page scroll; do not style `.record`/dashboard (chartwright owns src/dashboard.css).
2) src/controls.js — window.VIVARIUM_CONTROLS = { mount(rootEl, ctx), update(world, dtMs), setRunning(bool), setFinished(bool), destroy() }. Build all instrument rows dynamically into #instrument-body: seed stepper (+ recast button), mutation slider, regrowth slider, generations stepper, speed rotary dial, catastrophe interval rotary dial, catastrophes toggle, trails toggle. Each row: small-caps label, (i) help button, 76x22 canvas sparkline of effect, custom instrument, mono live readout with units, engraved scale where apt. Must implement full keyboard semantics (native range where possible; custom dials role=slider with arrow/page/home/end + pointer drag/angle), aria-valuetext, aria-describedby tooltips, visible focus, Escape dismiss, tooltip positioning inside viewport. Sparkline data comes from ctx.getSparkData(). Use ctx.setParam/actions; readouts update in update(world,dt). Persist drawer fold state. No external assets/libraries/fonts. All CSS in design.css, all JS in controls.js. Do not edit shell/engine/render/boot/dashboard or round 1/index.html.
Build preview with: node assemble.mjs --out shots/preview-atelier.html --quiet, then headless Chrome screenshot with a unique --user-data-dir. Iterate visually with read_image. Report back concise summary, files, any contract deviation.
Write scopes: src/design.css, src/controls.js, shots/preview-atelier.html

tasks.subject: Chartwright: THE RECORD canvas dashboard (pop curves + trait drift mean/spread)
tasks.description:
Read DESIGN-BRIEF.md, src/shell.html (record section) and src/engine.js contract. Own and build:
1) src/dashboard.js — window.VIVARIUM_DASHBOARD = { render(world, opts), show(), hide(), onResize() }. Draw on #chart-pop: population curves for flora/herbivora/carnivora over generations, species colors/glyphs, axes with units, catastrophe markers (vertical rust dashed rules + tiny wax pins/labels), end-state labels, hand-drawn deterministic jitter from world.seed. Draw on #chart-traits: one canvas matrix, 3 taxa rows x 4 gene columns, each cell mean line + ±1 SD spread band over generations, per-gene y range/units, shared x axis, catastrophe markers faint; row labels with taxon + glyph, column titles with gene + species-specific expression note (see brief). Fill #record-summary with a considered summary card (final counts, catastrophe roster, largest drop, survival/extinction note, mean mutation rate, diversity) and #record-notes with weather roster / closing observation. DPR-aware, reflows on resize. All canvas 2D, no libraries/external assets. Ink-on-paper visual language, restrained, legible at 1280px. Must fit 1440x900 without scrolling. Accessibility: canvases have role=img labels already; summary as semantic text.
2) src/dashboard.css — styles for .record overlay, sheet, header/actions, chart captions, layout grid, summary card, footer, responsive; same tokens as design.css. Do not edit design.css/shell/boot/engine/render/controls or round 1/index.html.
Test with mock history data in a throwaway harness under shots/ (scope allows shots/chart-*). Once Lead's boot lands, test via node assemble.mjs --out shots/preview-chart.html --quiet and URL ?seed=1977&gens=6&speed=8, then trigger window.__VIVARIUM__.conclude(). Screenshot + read_image; iterate. Report concise summary + any contract needs.
Write scopes: src/dashboard.js, src/dashboard.css, shots/chart-*

tasks.subject: Verifier: independent QA — determinism, no-network, controls, dashboard, screenshots
tasks.description:
Read DESIGN-BRIEF.md and the acceptance checklist. You are the independent verifier; never edit deliverable/module files (only verify/** and shots/verify-*). Build a repeatable QA harness and execute it against the assembled page (Lead keeps round 1/index.html current; previews available at shots/preview-*.html). Check and report, with severity and repro:
ENGINE (node, vm-load src/engine.js with fake window): same seed => identical world hash after N gens; different seed => different; deterministic across separate processes; all random from seeded PRNG (grep for Math.random/Date in engine); runHeadless speed (e.g. 100 gens < 1s); generation history has counts + all 3 taxa x 4 gene mean/sd for each gen; catastrophes fire at configured interval and 3 types appear; live param changes apply; no NaNs, no negative populations, no runaway growth; extinction handled.
BROWSER (headless Chrome via CLI screenshot and/or CDP over node WebSocket — do not install packages): page auto-starts and generation advances; zero console errors/pageerrors; zero network requests beyond the local file (capture Network events or performance resource entries); URL params work; controls render (6 instruments + 2 toggles + sparklines); every control keyboard reachable/adjustable with visible focus; tooltips on focus/hover; folio fold/unfold preserves tab order sanity; pause/step/conclude work; catastrophe banner + rule seal + ledger entry + wash happen; N-generation auto-end transitions to THE RECORD; dashboard canvases non-blank (pixel variance), charts have data, summary populated; no page scroll at 1440x900; sanity at 1280x800; reduced-motion; skip link; no external font/image/library requests; single-file check (no src/href to non-local, no fetch/XHR/import/CDN).
VISUAL: capture screenshots 1440x900 at initial, mid-run, event moment, final record; 1280x800; inspect them via read_image for layout collisions, clipping, illegible text, weak composition. Give actionable notes.
Deliverables: verify/REPORT.md with PASS/FAIL matrix + screenshots list + prioritized issues; rerun after Lead fixes and update report. Message the Lead with concise findings (include task/repro/expected). Do not edit src/**, round 1/**, DESIGN-BRIEF.md, assemble.mjs.
Write scopes: verify/, shots/verify-
